family: BMW Motorrad CAN research (broadcast frames only)
display_name: BMW Motorrad CAN research placeholder (R / S / F / G series)
notes: Common BMW Motorrad models (R 1250 GS, R 1300 GS, S 1000 RR/XR, R nineT, F 850 GS, F 900 XR, G 310 R). The only recovered evidence is EasierCan's MIT-licensed BMW R1300GS capture: three 11-bit broadcast frames (0x10C engine speed, 0x2D0 high-beam flash bit, 0x2D2 switch cluster) with arithmetic formulas, decoded offline by the brand-tools panel. The source does not record frame direction and matching IDs do not establish fitment. No BMW diagnostic session, UDS/KWP-on-CAN definition, DTC or memory protocol was recovered, so this is an unknown zero-capability placeholder and physical use is blocked.

can.note: 11-bit classic CAN broadcast frames are documented for one R1300GS capture; no diagnostic request/response identifiers are claimed.

session.physical_blocked_reason: Only offline broadcast-frame decoding from one R1300GS capture exists; no BMW diagnostic application protocol or validated CAN identifier pair was recovered.

memory.write_blocked_reason: No BMW memory-access sequence, geometry or security definition was recovered; this build refuses the operation.

sources: https://github.com/SchwarzeLanzenreiter/MotoRecoLogger/tree/30e08e034ac2f58ce6c3e5ba930bfa4b1108f4da (MIT): BMW Motorrad CAN logger tooling; no captures bundled
